name: Incoming e-invoice: data row + readable copy (invowerk)

parameters.content:
## Incoming e-invoices, made readable
Watches a mailbox. For every XML or PDF attachment it:
- reads the invoice with invowerk (**Parse Invoice**) and appends one row to a sheet: number, dates, seller, totals, IBAN;
- for XML invoices (XRechnung), renders a readable HTML view (**Render Invoice**) and emails it to your bookkeeping address.

### Setup
1. Install the community node `@invowerk-dev/n8n-nodes-invowerk`.
2. Get an API key: https://invowerk.dev/go/tpl-eingehende-e-rechnung-lesbar?to=/app/api-keys
3. Connect IMAP and SMTP, pick the sheet in **Append to invoice log**, set the address in **Send readable copy**.
4. Test: email yourself https://invowerk.dev/app-static/demo/beispiel-xrechnung.xml

### Plain PDFs
**Parse invoice** continues on error: a PDF without embedded invoice data still gets a row, with the reason in `status`.

nodes.name: Note: not every PDF is an e-invoice

parameters.content:
### Labels
**Render readable view** uses German labels (`lang = de`). Set `en` for English.
